title: Introduction to Git Branches
overview: A Git branch is a separate line of development that allows developers to work on features without affecting the main code.

example.title: Branch Concept
example.content:
Main Branch
     |
Feature Branch
     |
New Feature Development

title: Creating a Branch
overview: A new branch can be created to start working on a separate feature or task.

title: Switching Branches
overview: Developers can switch between branches to work on different versions of the project.

example.title: Switch Branch
example.content:
git checkout feature-login

or

git switch feature-login

title: Listing Branches
overview: Git provides commands to view all available branches in a repository.

title: Deleting a Branch
overview: Branches that are no longer required can be removed from the repository.

title: Branch Naming Practices
overview: Using meaningful branch names helps teams understand the purpose of each branch.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how branches work, how to create and manage branches, and why branching is important in development.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Branches separate work.
✔ Features use separate branches.
✔ Clean naming improves teamwork.
